metadata.description: 6 by 5.2 meter layered garden tile with inset opaque teal pond, two soil terraces, a warm path and sparse broad corner patches.
Original cuboid canopy tree; broad lime top, olive lower canopy, one sparse corner highlight and a square wooden trunk.
Original cuboid canopy tree; broad lime top, olive lower canopy, one sparse corner highlight and a square wooden trunk.
Connected three-post plank fence with two broad horizontal rails.
Original oak garden bench, broad seat and one simple backrest.
Original raised SEED marker: simple turquoise board on a square wooden post.
Two square pond reeds with ochre tips; a connected dark teal root base sits on the pond surface.
Connected blocky lily pad with an original stepped notch and one pale flower; surface prop touches water without overlap.
Original connected miniature fish, teal cuboid body and blue square tail. Artistic pond surface silhouette.
Connected five-cell-wide flower with square petals and warm center.
Original small cluster of two cuboid grass blades on a connected root base.

description: Original Greenbox seedling garden: a warm layered 6 by 5.2 meter outdoor voxel tile with broad lime and olive cube tree canopies, a stepped sand path, a turquoise pond, fish, lily pads, square reeds, an oak bench, flowers, plank fence, SEED marker, a new compact Rasta grower, preserved CC0-leaf-derived potted plant assets and a watering can. Source shapes are occupied cubes and colors remain the canonical indexed Greenbox palette. Garden theme is a global presentation remap. Static game art diorama only.
